payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerates four sign cases for absolute differences, solves linear equations for wins, and checks feasibility (non-negative, within remaining games).
payload.rationale: Solution brute-forces all possible sign assignments for d1 and d2, which is a complete search over a tiny domain. No advanced search algorithm is used, but mapping to complete_search subtypes, branch-and-bound loosely fits due to bounding checks.
